case_title: Ude Singh & Ors. v. State of Haryana
aggravating_circumstances: Continuous humiliation and taunting leading to suicide
trial_court_outcome: Guilty of offence punishable under s.306 r/w s.34 and awarded four years RI
high_court_outcome: Upheld conviction but modified sentence to two and a half years RI
neutral_facts: The accused, who were relatives of the victim, engaged in continuous harassment and humiliation of the victim, a 18-year-old girl, by addressing her with derogatory terms such as 'wife', 'Chachi', and 'Bohoria'. The victim had previously broken off her engagement and faced ongoing taunts from the accused. The harassment escalated on the day of the incident, leading to the victim's suicide by hanging. The prosecution's case was based on the continuous nature of the harassment and its direct link to the victim's decision to end her life. The trial court convicted the accused under Section 306 of the IPC, and the High Court upheld the conviction but reduced the sentence.
